Website privacy

Last updated: 1 November 2026

This notice covers the PulseZones website, operated by the PulseZones developer. It is separate from the Android app’s privacy policy.

What stays in your browser

Choosing a language saves its code and an expiry date in localStorage. Clicking “OK, understood” saves this notice’s version and an expiry date. Both preferences are used for up to 90 days; expired records are removed when read. These values are not sent to the developer. You can remove them by clearing this website’s browser data. Browser-language detection and the heart rate calculator run locally; calculator inputs are not submitted or saved by the website.

GitHub Pages hosting

GitHub Pages serves this website. GitHub states that it logs and stores visitors’ IP addresses for security, even when visitors are not signed in. This processing is governed by GitHub’s privacy statement. The developer has not installed analytics, advertising trackers or visitor profiling tools on this website.

GitHub

If you contact the developer

Email is voluntary. The developer receives your email address and any information you include, uses it to respond or consider your feedback, and retains correspondence as needed for that purpose. Do not send sensitive health information. For privacy questions or requests concerning your correspondence, contact:

pulsezones@proton.me

The Android app has a separate policy

This website does not receive your app profile, heart rate, GPS routes or workout history. The app’s own data processing, including crash diagnostics, is described in its separate privacy policy.

Android app privacy policy

Links to other services

Following links to Google Play, social platforms or other websites takes you to services with their own privacy practices. This website does not embed their tracking widgets. The “OK” button only dismisses this information notice; it is not consent to advertising tracking.
